text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm about to begin training with Mihono Bourbon. She usually finishes getting ready well before we're supposed to start, but today's different.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …One minute left until training begins. Thank you for waiting, Master.
choice_data_list: It's rare to see you cut it so close.
It's rare to see you cut it so close.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. You see—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: FOUND YA!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bourbon! Our discussion isn't over!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Indeed. However, it is already time for my training to begin. I am thus unable to debate any longer.
choice_data_list: Is there some kind of dispute?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's correct! The topic at hand is why she keeps breaking our vending machines!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As class representative, it is my responsibility to prevent the destruction of school property!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Any machinery I come into contact with breaks down without exception. The cause is unknown. It is not done with intention.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I know you don't mean to break them! But there's still room for discussion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O spreads her arms wide as if to prevent Mihono Bourbon from running away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To be fair, it is pretty weird to be able to break machines just by touching them. An investigation may be worthwhile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But for now, the issue at hand is that the vending machines are out of service. Maybe we need some kind of countermeasure.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Are you listening to me, Bourbon?! I want to hear your master's thoughts on the issue too.
choice_data_list: I guess it's not good that no one can use the vending machines, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh? Yes, you're right about that.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, Master. I recognize the situation is very "inconvenient."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Vending machines are essential when one cannot refill their water bottle or purchase a drink from the store.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But… I cannot use them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We can't let things continue like this. If I'm with her, it's fine, but if I'm not…
choice_data_list: Ask a friend to use the machine for you from now on.
Try using some kind of tool to touch the machine.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A friend… I have determined that option to be difficult.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: First, there are very few people that I can refer to as friends.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Second, those few friends will not necessarily be nearby when—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Then just call me over! No matter the time, no matter the place, I'll Bakushin right to you in a flash!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As class representative, I can't abandon a student in need! And besides, we're friends!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …We are?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Of course we are! Aren't you proud to have the class representative as a friend?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Not particularly. But yes… we are friends…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I can imagine how thrilled you are about that, but don't just stand there repeating it. You're gonna make me blush.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Understood. I will call for you when I need to use a vending machine, Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yeah, just leave it to me, the perfect role model for all students—the class representative, Sakura Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …My friend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From then on…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I start to notice Mihono Bourbon near vending machines at times, restlessly searching for her friend, Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A tool… perhaps something like tongs?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see! You've got a good head on your shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You can use them to put your money in and all that without actually touching the machine! Let's go try it out later!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. I will do as Master commands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, Mihono Bourbon tries using tongs to operate a vending machine.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Uh, what's all this? Why're you using tongs, Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Do you want to buy some juice or something? I'll press the buttons for you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe… You don't need those tongs, Bourbon. I'll help you out—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah… sorry. I can't reach the top button… Can you give me a boost?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Since then, people nearby always end up helping me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Based on this experience, I have determined that asking for help is more efficient than using tongs.
choice_data_list: Sounds like a plan to me!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Despite my lack of communication skills, someone will help me if I ask.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will be sure to record this in my memory logs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like Mihono Bourbon has plenty of friends willing to help her—she just hadn't realized it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now, she knows just how important it is to rely on others.
